# ProposalIQ

> AI-powered RFP proposal generation for architecture and design firms.

ProposalIQ helps small architecture and design firms generate polished,
firm-specific proposal drafts from RFP documents using AI — in minutes, not days.

## Product
- Upload RFP documents (PDF or Word)
- AI generates tailored proposal drafts based on your firm's knowledge base
- Built-in refinement, export and print tools
- Win/loss analytics tracking

## Target Users
Small architecture and interior design firms (10-50 employees) who respond
to RFPs and want to reduce proposal writing time.

## Pricing
- Solo: $99/month
- Studio: $199/month
- Firm: $399/month
- 90-day free beta trial available
